mission: Enter the full breach zone to understand de-structuring at maximum scale and determine whether the wound can be contained.
why_now: The group has encountered thin places but never a full breach. The seal's deterioration has created one. Direct experience is necessary to understand what they're trying to prevent — and to reveal each character's true relationship to de-structuring.
conflict: Ben vs. the de-structured Force — existential, experiential
turning_point: Torin smiled in the breach zone. The wrong reaction to the de-structured Force is the first real warning that his certainty is not strength — it's the lie consuming him.
setting: A world where the seal has fully failed locally — complete breach zone
emotional_trajectory: The abstract becomes visceral. Loss of structure is loss of moral compass.
notes: Group exits fundamentally changed. Ben terrified. Sera shaken. Torin smiled. Kael disturbed by his own comfort. Veraine's deliberate sabotage confirmed. Mission shifts from investigation to urgency.
